facts.fact: Mali Actuel reports the Mines Minister said the new mining cadastre was designed and developed 100% by Malian public administration staff and is fully functional with 631 mining titles, presented on 17 April 2026.
Mali Actuel reports the Mines Minister said the new mining cadastre replaced an old system that depended on foreign companies, and is now entirely developed by Malians.

MLI.note: The digital cadastre is of mining titles, not land rights and parcels.
